comment: splanc HITL fleet expressed in the hitl-reserve catalog schema. Mirrors the SKUs in //pi/hitl:skus.bzl and the network-DUT / shared-analyzer wiring of the existing cmd/hitl-managerd daemon. Set host/workspace per rig at launch (--host --workspace) or here.

shared_resources.comment: One FX2/fx2lafw logic analyzer whose channels tap each DUT's LED line. Dormant unless an FX2 is attached (HardwareProbe). Default map taps D0/ws2812 so a discovered single-board rig captures its sole DUT; per-unit channels can be set at runtime via `hitl shared logic-analyzer {"op":"map.set",...}`.
shared_resources.name: logic-analyzer

components.comment: The LED Mapper Pi — a network DUT reached over the tailnet/LAN and provisioned over BLE; no board on this rig. Seed its real address per deployment.
components.name: led-mapper-pi-1

units.comment: The Pi player as a pin-only network unit: ordinary caps-only work never drifts onto the scarce Pi; reach it with --unit led-mapper-pi-1 or --type led-mapper-pi.
units.name: led-mapper-pi-1

discovery.comment: Auto-discover attached ESP32-C6 player boards by their built-in USB-JTAG by-id symlinks — one reservable unit per board, sticky ports, live hot-plug. Each discovered unit unions in the analyzer tap cap (logic-analyzer-led-strip) from the broker's channel map, exactly like the managerd rig.
